notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34144000/ea5b2769d29ce4b46cb5bfc8d67791407ab1218f.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34144000/7d907479528b3d84ccd8e4138e689448a289d0fb.png[/img][/url]

Hello Eveyone,

This is the first devlog for Decisions! As you might be aware this game has been awaiting a final release date but, no longer! As sadly I am pushing the date of the release back just a tiny bit as there are some annoying bugs that need to be squashed. And the base game is still under construction for now. But, don’t worry the new date is the 9th of August 2019. Now I assure you that this date is the date the game finally releases!!!! Stay tuned for some sneaky sneak peaks and trailers that are to come. Check out the [url=https://m.youtube.com/channel/UCSg0xjwcVjw0j5GnxWxan1Q]Sevo Tech YouTube Chanel[/url] for the upcoming trailers and the Sevo Tech Twitter and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/34151276]Sevo Tech Group on Steam[/url]​ for some sneak peaks and a chance to win a free game key.

- Sevo Tech

notes.title: First Mode Anouncement!!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34144000/ea5b2769d29ce4b46cb5bfc8d67791407ab1218f.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34144000/7d907479528b3d84ccd8e4138e689448a289d0fb.png[/img][/url]
Hello again everyone to the announcement of the first EVER mode in Decisions!! Just a quick note this mode will come with the game it will not be a DLC. What is this mode? it is called the lightning mode: 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34144000/e396ec96e992c7a9f07ae98a1f9e29af6843a1b3.png[/img]
Pretty sick pic (lol) anyways this is just a release mode so when the first [i]actual[/i] mode comes this mode will be deleted!

[h1]What can you do in this mode?[/h1]

Its what its says kinda you have to click buttons '1', '2' & '3'  Extremely quickly to beat your record and the world record in this game which will show on the leaderboard so this mode is currently being worked on and will come out with the release of the game!

- Sevo Tech
